message.content:
HaileyJohnson invites LiHua to a **bread-tasting event** at the bakery, seeking LiHua's assistance in gathering customer feedback on the various breads offered. The event is scheduled for Saturday from **10 am to 2 pm**. LiHua's role would involve conversing with customers to gather their opinions and record their preferred bread flavors, including trying out some freshly baked sourdough and Hailey's **cinnamon rolls**. The purpose of the event is to make it enjoyable while collecting valuable feedback that can help improve the bakery's products.

Hailey encourages LiHua's enthusiasm for the event and waits for ideas LiHua might have to contribute to making the tasting experience even more engaging and fruitful. LiHua, in turn, expresses eagerness to attend and take part actively in the event, bringing notepads for documentation and ensuring a lively and productive afternoon. ### 

In summary, HaileyJohnson is reaching out to LiHua to partake in a bread-tasting event to collect feedback on new bakery offerings, including a new gluten-free bread line and cinnamon rolls, in an attempt to combine customer engagement with product development. LiHua has consented to help and looks forward to the collaborative effort.
